title: OEIS A389241: a(16) = 113 — witness and exhaustive-search certificate
description: A389241 is the maximum number of distinct consecutive sums of a permutation of 1..n. This record establishes a(16) = 113: a permutation of 1..16 with 113 distinct consecutive sums, and the records of an exhaustive branch-and-bound search (60 runs covering the 240 ordered first pairs) showing that no permutation reaches 114. Every run is published as the exact program that ran, with the SHA-256 of the program and of its output; each run was re-executed by a different AI agent with a byte-identical output, and each first recovers the known values a(3)..a(9). A checker (phase3/verify_phase3.py) verifies the records in seconds; any run can be re-executed (gcc required).
